title: Additive Number

monster.name: Additive Sphinx
monster.title: Verifier of Consecutive Sums
monster.defeatQuote: A valid additive sequence was verified across the string!

description: An additive number is a string whose digits can form an additive sequence: num1 + num2 = num3. Given a string containing only digits, return `True` if it is an additive number or `False` otherwise.
solutionCode:
def isAdditiveNumber(num: str) -> bool:
    n = len(num)
    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            s1, s2 = num[:i], num[i:j]
            if (len(s1) > 1 and s1[0] == '0') or (len(s2) > 1 and s2[0] == '0'): continue
            n1, n2 = int(s1), int(s2)
            k = j
            valid = True
            while k < n:
                n3 = n1 + n2
                s3 = str(n3)
                if not num.startswith(s3, k):
                    valid = False
                    break
                k += len(s3)
                n1, n2 = n2, n3
            if valid and k == n: return True
    return False
